title: refactor(GroundTheory/HeightsAndTheta/Heights): share field-generic ChartResidueDegree.length_eq_one with PChartResidueDegreeAlgClosed
body:
Extract the shared proof body of `ChartResidueDegree.proof` and `ChartResidueDegreeAlgClosed.proof` into a field-generic lemma `ChartResidueDegree.length_eq_one` in `GroundTheory/HeightsAndTheta/Heights/ChowForms/PChartResidueDegree.lean`, parameterized directly by the birationality hypothesis over `F` without requiring `[CharZero F]` or `[IsAlgClosed F]`. Both `ChartResidueDegree.proof` and `ChartResidueDegreeAlgClosed.proof` now delegate directly to `ChartResidueDegree.length_eq_one`, removing the duplicated 233-line proof and unused private imports from `PChartResidueDegreeAlgClosed.lean`.

Declarations changed:
- Added: `GroundTheory.Heights₂.Heights.ChartResidueDegree.length_eq_one` (in `PChartResidueDegree.lean`).
- Refactored: `GroundTheory.Heights₂.Heights.ChartResidueDegree.proof` and `GroundTheory.Heights₂.Heights.ChartResidueDegreeAlgClosed.proof` (unchanged signatures).
